blocks.text: Fe'l shakllari: qizil kitobdan keyingi bosqich

To'g'ri va noto'g'ri fe'llarning asoslari qizil kitobda o'tilgan: `-ed` qoidasi (→ qizil kitob, 24-dars), eng ko'p ishlatiladigan yuzga yaqin noto'g'ri fe'l alifbo tartibida (→ qizil kitob, 117-dars) va shakli o'xshash guruhlarda (→ qizil kitob, 118-dars). Ularni bilasiz deb hisoblaymiz. Bu ilovada uch narsa yangi: 1) fe'lning beshta shakli B1–B2 darajasida qayerlarda ishlatilishi; 2) yangiliklar, kitoblar va rasmiy matnlarda uchraydigan **kam uchraydigan noto'g'ri fe'llar** (bear, bind, cling, seek, strive, swear, tread, weave, withdraw...); 3) shakli o'xshash, lekin ma'nosi boshqa fe'llar (rise / raise, wind / wound, hang / hanged).

rows: Present Simple; to + V1; modal fe'l + V1 (must **withdraw**); buyruq gap; let / make + V1
Present Simple, he / she / it bilan
perfekt zamonlar, majhul nisbat, modal + have + V3, sifat vazifasida (pastda)

blocks.text: B1–B2 darajasida eng ko'p ish **V3** ga tushadi. Qizil kitobda u asosan Present Perfect va oddiy majhul nisbatda kelgan edi. Endi esa V3 deyarli har bir murakkab tuzilmaning ichida bor. Shuning uchun noto'g'ri fe'lning V3 shaklini bilmaslik bitta xatoga emas, butun gapning buzilishiga olib keladi:

items: Perfekt zamonlar: has **sworn**, had **fled**, will have **undergone** (→ 7, 15, 24-darslar);
Majhul nisbat: was **woven**, is being **swept**, has been **withdrawn** (→ 42–44-darslar);
Modal + have + V3: must have **misled**, should have **sought**, could have **foreseen** (→ 27, 28, 34-darslar);
Sifat vazifasida: a **frozen** lake, a **swollen** knee, **sworn** enemies, **spilt** milk;
Qisqargan ergash gaplar va have something done: the money **withdrawn** yesterday (→ 97-dars), I had my coat **sewn** (→ 46-dars).

items.text: The suspect **had fled** the country before the police arrived.
items.translation: Politsiya yetib kelguncha gumondor mamlakatdan **qochib ketgan edi**.

items.text: This decision **should have been foreseen** months ago.
items.translation: Bu qarorni bir necha oy oldin **oldindan ko'rish kerak edi**.

items.text: We walked carefully across the **frozen** river.

blocks.text: Kam uchraydigan noto'g'ri fe'llar: qolipga qarab

Quyidagi fe'llar qizil kitob ro'yxatida yo'q, lekin gazeta, kitob, rasmiy xat va yangiliklarda tez-tez uchraydi. Ular alifbo bo'yicha emas, o'zgarish **qolipi** bo'yicha berilgan: har bir guruhda siz allaqachon biladigan «namuna» fe'l bor. Masalan, sweep → **swept** xuddi sleep → slept kabi, swear → **swore** → **sworn** esa wear → wore → worn kabi o'zgaradi. Yangi fe'lni tanish fe'lga bog'lab yodlash ancha oson.

items.text: Someone **has spilt** coffee all over my notes.
The patient **was bleeding** heavily, so they called an ambulance.
items.translation: Bemordan qattiq **qon ketayotgan edi**, shuning uchun tez yordam chaqirishdi.

items.text: Lightning **struck** the old tower but didn't damage it.
items.translation: Eski minoraga chaqmoq **urdi**, lekin unga zarar yetkazmadi.

items.text: The new rules are confusing, and several problems **have** already **arisen**.
items.translation: Yangi qoidalar chalkash, bir nechta muammo allaqachon **yuzaga kelgan**.

items.text: Her face **was swollen** after the dentist removed her tooth.
items.translation: Tish shifokori tishini sug'urgandan keyin uning yuzi **shishib ketgan edi**.

blocks.text: Old qo'shimchali fe'llar asosiy fe'ldek o'zgaradi

over-, under-, with-, fore-, mis-, out-, re-, up- kabi old qo'shimchali fe'llar alohida yodlanmaydi: ular ichidagi asosiy fe'l qanday o'zgarsa, xuddi shunday o'zgaradi. take → took → taken bo'lsa, undertake → under**took** → under**taken**. forgive va understand ni qizil kitobdan bilasiz — ular ham shu qoidaga bo'ysunadi (give, stand).
Ikki xil shakl: Britaniya va Amerika

Ba'zi fe'llarning `-t` va `-ed` li ikki shakli bor. Britaniya inglizchasida ikkalasi ham ishlatiladi (learnt va learned), Amerika inglizchasida esa deyarli doim `-ed`. Sifat vazifasida Britaniyada `-t` li shakl ko'proq: **spilt** milk, **spoilt** child. Bir nechta fe'lda farq boshqacha (Amerika inglizchasi haqida batafsil → 152-dars):

rows: spill, spoil, leap, kneel, lean, dwell

blocks.text: Quyidagi juftlarda bir fe'lning V2 yoki V3 shakli boshqa fe'lning V1 shakliga o'xshaydi. Ko'pincha biri o'timsiz (harakat o'zi bo'ladi), ikkinchisi o'timli (kimdir nimanidir qiladi). Ikkinchi fe'llarning aksariyati **to'g'ri** fe'l ekaniga e'tibor bering.

rows: She **has borne** a lot. / She **was born** in 1990.

items.text: The sun **rose** at six, and we **raised** the flag at seven.
items.translation: Quyosh oltida **chiqdi**, biz esa bayroqni yettida **ko'tardik**.

items.text: The museum **was founded** by a man who **had found** an ancient coin in his garden.
items.translation: Muzeyga bog'idan qadimiy tanga **topib olgan** odam **asos solgan**.

items.text: Two people **were wounded** when the roof collapsed.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Prices raised last year.» → Prices **rose** (narx o'zi oshadi — rise); «I was borned in Fergana.» → I **was born**; «She has sweared.» → She has **sworn**; «He has overcame his fear.» → has **overcome** (come kabi: V3 = V1); «My T-shirt shrinked.» → **shrank**; «They seeked help.» → **sought**; «It is forbidded.» → **forbidden**; «I have withdrawed money.» → **withdrawn**; «The match was broadcasted» — xato emas, lekin Britaniyada **was broadcast** ko'proq.

Yangi noto'g'ri fe'lni har doim tanish «juftiga» bog'lang: swear – wear, sweep – sleep, shrink – drink, arise – rise, withdraw – draw, undertake – take. Juftini topa olmasangiz (forbid, tread, weave), uchta shaklni bitta gap qilib yodlang: «They **forbade** it, it **is forbidden**.»

Bog'liq darslar: → qizil kitob, 24-dars (to'g'ri va noto'g'ri fe'llar), 117–118-darslar (asosiy ro'yxat va guruhlar); `-ed`, `-ing` imlosi → 151-dars; V3 ishlatiladigan tuzilmalar → 7, 15, 27, 42–46, 97-darslar.

examples.title: Same in all three forms: **burst**, **cast**, **shed**
examples.description: Uchala shakli bir xil yangi fe'llar: burst, broadcast, forecast, cast, shed, split, upset, bid. Zamonni yordamchi fe'l va vaqt so'zlari ko'rsatadi.

sentences.text: A water pipe **burst** in our kitchen last night, and the floor is still wet.
sentences.translation: Kecha tunda oshxonamizda suv quvuri **yorilib ketdi**, pol hali ham ho'l.

sentences.text: The final **was broadcast** live on national TV and watched by millions.
sentences.translation: Final milliy telekanalda jonli **efirga uzatildi** va uni millionlab odamlar tomosha qildi.

sentences.text: The weather service **forecast** sunshine for Saturday, but it rained all day in Fergana.
sentences.translation: Ob-havo xizmati shanba kuni quyoshli bo'lishini **bashorat qilgandi**, lekin Farg'onada kun bo'yi yomg'ir yog'di.

sentences.text: Who **cast** him as the villain? He's far too kind for that role.
sentences.translation: Uni yovuz qahramon roliga kim **tanladi**? U bu rol uchun haddan tashqari mehribon-ku.

sentences.text: The plane trees on our street **have** already **shed** most of their leaves.
sentences.translation: Ko'chamizdagi chinorlar barglarining ko'pini allaqachon **to'kib bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: After a long argument, Bekzod and his business partner **split** the profits equally.
sentences.translation: Uzoq bahsdan keyin Bekzod va sherigi foydani teng **bo'lishdi**.

sentences.text: Has anything **upset** you? You've hardly said a word all evening.
sentences.translation: Biror narsa sizni **xafa qildimi**? Kechqurun bo'yi deyarli gapirmadingiz.

sentences.text: Three companies **bid** for the contract, but the cheapest offer didn't win.
sentences.translation: Shartnoma uchun uchta kompaniya **taklif berdi**, lekin eng arzon taklif yutmadi.

sentences.text: When she heard the news, Grandma **burst** into tears of joy.
sentences.translation: Xabarni eshitgach, buvim quvonchdan **yig'lab yubordi**.

sentences.text: Sarah and James **split** up in March, but they're still good friends.
sentences.translation: Sara va Jeyms mart oyida **ajrashishdi**, lekin hali ham yaxshi do'st.

examples.title: V2 = V3 with **-t** / **-d**: crept, swept, knelt, fled
examples.description: V2 va V3 bir xil, oxiri `-t` yoki `-d`: bleed, breed, flee, creep, sweep, weep, kneel, deal, leap, spoil. Namunalari tanish: sleep → slept, feed → fed.

sentences.text: After I cut my finger on a broken glass, it **bled** for ages.
sentences.translation: Singan stakanga barmog'imni kesib olganimdan keyin u uzoq **qonab turdi**.

sentences.text: Our cat **crept** up on a pigeon, but the bird flew away just in time.
sentences.translation: Mushugimiz kaptarga **sekin yaqinlashdi**, lekin qush o'z vaqtida uchib ketdi.

sentences.text: Have you **swept** the yard yet? The guests are arriving in an hour.
sentences.translation: Hovlini **supurdingmi**? Mehmonlar bir soatdan keyin keladi.

sentences.text: Grandpa **knelt** down to tie his grandson's shoelaces.
sentences.translation: Bobom nevarasining poyabzal bog'ichini bog'lash uchun **tiz cho'kdi**.

sentences.text: Thousands of families **fled** the area when the river flooded their villages.
sentences.translation: Daryo qishloqlarini suv bosganda minglab oilalar u hududdan **qochib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Don't worry, Malika **has dealt** with far more difficult clients than this one.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang, Malika bundan ancha qiyin mijozlar bilan ham **ishlagan**.

sentences.text: Racehorses **are bred** on this farm near Jizzakh.
sentences.translation: Jizzax yaqinidagi bu fermada poyga otlari **yetishtiriladi**.

sentences.text: When Pakhtakor scored in the last minute, the fans **leapt** to their feet.
sentences.translation: Paxtakor so'nggi daqiqada gol urganda muxlislar o'rnidan **sakrab turdi**.

sentences.text: She **wept** at the airport as her son walked through passport control.
sentences.translation: O'g'li pasport nazoratidan o'tib ketayotganda u aeroportda **yig'ladi**.

sentences.text: Heavy rain **spoilt** our picnic, so we ate the sandwiches in the car.
sentences.translation: Kuchli yomg'ir piknikimizni **buzdi**, shuning uchun buterbrodlarni mashinada yedik.

examples.title: **sought**, **bound**, **ground**, **wound**, **misled**
examples.description: Unlisi o'zgaradigan A – B – B fe'llar: seek → sought, bind → bound, grind → ground, wind → wound, mislead → misled, withhold → withheld, overhear → overheard.

sentences.text: Before signing the deal, the company **sought** advice from two lawyers.
sentences.translation: Bitimni imzolashdan oldin kompaniya ikki advokatdan **maslahat so'radi**.

sentences.text: When I was a child, my grandmother **ground** coffee beans by hand every morning.
sentences.translation: Bolaligimda buvim har kuni ertalab qahva donlarini qo'lda **yanchardi**.

sentences.text: Have you **wound** the old clock? It stopped at half past three.
sentences.translation: Eski soatni **burab qo'ydingizmi**? U uch yarimda to'xtab qolgan.

sentences.text: All the documents **were bound** into a thick book and sent to the ministry.
sentences.translation: Barcha hujjatlar qalin kitob qilib **muqovalandi** va vazirlikka yuborildi.

sentences.text: Many buyers felt they **had been misled** by the advert.
sentences.translation: Ko'p xaridorlar reklama ularni **chalg'itgan** deb hisoblashdi.

sentences.text: The police **withheld** the driver's name until his family had been informed.
sentences.translation: Politsiya haydovchining oilasiga xabar berilmaguncha uning ismini **oshkor qilmadi**.

sentences.text: Without meaning to, Aziz **overheard** his colleagues talking about the new boss.
sentences.translation: Aziz bilmagan holda hamkasblarining yangi boshliq haqidagi gapini **eshitib qoldi**.

sentences.text: The narrow road **wound** up the mountain towards the village of Sijjak.
sentences.translation: Tor yo'l tog' bo'ylab Sijjak qishlog'i tomon **ilon izi bo'lib ko'tarilardi**.

sentences.text: Young IT specialists from Tashkent are highly **sought** after abroad.
sentences.translation: Toshkentlik yosh IT mutaxassislari chet elda juda **talabgir**.

sentences.text: Over the centuries the river **has ground** the rocks into smooth pebbles.
sentences.translation: Asrlar davomida daryo qoyalarni silliq shag'alga **aylantirib yuborgan**.

examples.title: **shrank** / **shrunk**, **clung**, **stung**, **struck**
examples.description: i – a – u qolipi (shrink, spring, stink — drink kabi) va i → u qolipi (cling, fling, sting, swing, spin — V2 = V3), hamda strike → struck.

sentences.text: My favourite jumper **shrank** in the wash, and now it only fits my little sister.
sentences.translation: Sevimli sviterim yuvilganda **kirishib qoldi**, endi u faqat singlimga to'g'ri keladi.

sentences.text: The number of bees **has shrunk** dramatically over the last decade.
sentences.translation: So'nggi o'n yilda asalarilar soni keskin **kamayib ketgan**.

sentences.text: A huge dog **sprang** out from behind the gate and frightened us.
sentences.translation: Darvoza ortidan ulkan it **otilib chiqdi** va bizni qo'rqitib yubordi.

sentences.text: The fridge **stank** because someone had left fish in it for a week.
sentences.translation: Muzlatgich **sasib ketgan edi**, chunki kimdir unda bir hafta baliq qoldirgan ekan.

sentences.text: Frightened by the thunder, the little girl **clung** to her mother's hand.
sentences.translation: Momaqaldiroqdan qo'rqqan qizcha onasining qo'liga **mahkam yopishib oldi**.

sentences.text: I **was stung** by a wasp while we were eating watermelon in the garden.
sentences.translation: Bog'da tarvuz yeyayotganimizda meni ari **chaqib oldi**.

sentences.text: Until it got dark, the children **swung** on the old rope swing in the yard.
sentences.translation: Bolalar qorong'i tushguncha hovlidagi eski arg'imchoqda **uchishdi**.

sentences.text: On the icy road the car **spun** round twice, but luckily nobody was hurt.
sentences.translation: Muz yo'lda mashina ikki marta **aylanib ketdi**, lekin xayriyatki, hech kim jarohatlanmadi.

sentences.text: Angry with himself, Jasur **flung** his phone onto the sofa.
sentences.translation: O'zidan jahli chiqqan Jasur telefonini divanga **otib yubordi**.

sentences.text: When was Tashkent **struck** by the big earthquake? — In April 1966.
sentences.translation: Toshkentni katta zilzila qachon **larzaga solgan**? — 1966-yil aprelida.

examples.title: Three different forms: **arose** / **arisen**, **swore** / **sworn**
examples.description: Uchala shakli har xil fe'llar: arise, awake, bear, swear, forbid, strive, tread, weave. V3 ko'pincha `-n` / `-en` bilan tugaydi.

sentences.text: A serious problem **arose** when the supplier suddenly doubled its prices.
sentences.translation: Yetkazib beruvchi to'satdan narxlarni ikki baravar oshirganda jiddiy muammo **yuzaga keldi**.

sentences.text: If any questions **have arisen** since the meeting, please send them by email.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilishdan keyin savollar **paydo bo'lgan** bo'lsa, ularni elektron pochta orqali yuboring.

sentences.text: The witness **swore** that she had never seen the man before.
sentences.translation: Guvoh bu odamni ilgari hech qachon ko'rmaganiga **qasam ichdi**.

sentences.text: Smoking **is** strictly **forbidden** inside hospitals, schools and stadiums.
sentences.translation: Shifoxona, maktab va stadionlar ichida chekish qat'iyan **taqiqlangan**.

sentences.text: My parents **forbade** me to ride a motorbike until I was eighteen.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam o'n sakkiz yoshga to'lgunimcha mototsikl haydashimni **taqiqlashgan**.

sentences.text: All the costs of the repair **will be borne** by the landlord, not by us.
sentences.translation: Ta'mirning barcha xarajatlarini biz emas, uy egasi **o'z zimmasiga oladi**.

sentences.text: Somebody **has trodden** mud all over the new carpet!
sentences.translation: Kimdir yangi gilamni loy oyoq bilan **bosib tashlabdi**!

sentences.text: These silk scarves **were woven** by hand in a small workshop in Margilan.
sentences.translation: Bu ipak ro'mollar Marg'ilondagi kichik ustaxonada qo'lda **to'qilgan**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **awoke** at dawn, packed his rucksack and set off for the mountains.
sentences.translation: Bekzod tong saharda **uyg'ondi**, ryukzagini yig'di va tog'ga yo'l oldi.

sentences.text: Throughout her career, Dr Karimova **has striven** to make good healthcare available to everyone.
sentences.translation: Doktor Karimova butun faoliyati davomida sifatli tibbiy yordamni hamma uchun ochiq qilishga **intilib kelgan**.

examples.title: Prefix verbs: **withdrew**, **overcame**, **underwent**
examples.description: Old qo'shimchali fe'llar asosiy fe'ldek o'zgaradi: withdraw (draw), overcome (come), undergo (go), undertake / overtake / mistake (take), foresee (see), outgrow (grow), uphold (hold).

sentences.text: I **withdrew** two hundred dollars from the cash machine before the trip.
sentences.translation: Safardan oldin bankomatdan ikki yuz dollar **yechib oldim**.

sentences.text: Two players **have withdrawn** from the tournament because of injuries.
sentences.translation: Ikki o'yinchi jarohat sababli turnirdan **chiqib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Dilshod **overcame** his fear of flying and finally visited his brother in Seoul.
sentences.translation: Dilshod uchishdan qo'rqishini **yengdi** va nihoyat Seulga akasining oldiga bordi.

sentences.text: My father **underwent** heart surgery last spring and feels much better now.
sentences.translation: Otam o'tgan bahorda yurakdan **operatsiya bo'ldi** va hozir o'zini ancha yaxshi his qilyapti.

sentences.text: Nobody **foresaw** that the small start-up would become so successful.
sentences.translation: Kichik startap bunchalik muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishini hech kim **oldindan ko'rmagan edi**.

sentences.text: Sorry, I **mistook** you for your brother — you look so alike!
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, sizni akangiz deb **adashtiribman** — juda o'xshar ekansizlar!

sentences.text: A red sports car **overtook** us on a dangerous bend near the pass.
sentences.translation: Dovon yaqinidagi xavfli burilishda bizni qizil sport mashinasi **quvib o'tdi**.

sentences.text: The city council **has undertaken** to repair all the roads in the district by autumn.
sentences.translation: Shahar kengashi kuzgacha tumandagi barcha yo'llarni ta'mirlashni **o'z zimmasiga oldi**.

sentences.text: The kids **have outgrown** their winter boots again, so we need new ones.
sentences.translation: Bolalarga qishki etiklari yana **kichik bo'lib qolibdi**, yangisi kerak.

sentences.text: The court **upheld** the decision, so the factory will have to close.
sentences.translation: Sud qarorni **kuchda qoldirdi**, demak zavod yopilishiga to'g'ri keladi.

examples.title: V3 as an adjective: **woven**, **swollen**, **frozen**
examples.description: Noto'g'ri fe'lning V3 shakli sifat vazifasida: hand-**woven** carpets, a **swollen** ankle, **spilt** milk. V3 ni bilmasangiz, bunday birikmalarni ham to'g'ri qura olmaysiz.

sentences.text: Hand-**woven** carpets from Khiva are sold at very high prices in Europe.
sentences.translation: Xivaning qo'lda **to'qilgan** gilamlari Yevropada juda qimmat narxda sotiladi.

sentences.text: After the match, Timur's ankle was badly **swollen**, so he went to A&E.
sentences.translation: O'yindan keyin Temurning to'pig'i qattiq **shishib ketgan edi**, shuning uchun u shoshilinch yordam bo'limiga bordi.

sentences.text: According to doctors, **frozen** vegetables are just as healthy as fresh ones.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlarning aytishicha, **muzlatilgan** sabzavotlar yangisi kabi foydali.

sentences.text: The two neighbours have been **sworn** enemies since the argument over the fence.
sentences.translation: Devor ustidagi janjaldan beri ikki qo'shni **ashaddiy dushman**.

sentences.text: Customs officers found **forbidden** goods hidden in the back of the lorry.
sentences.translation: Bojxona xodimlari yuk mashinasining orqa qismiga yashirilgan **taqiqlangan** mollarni topishdi.

sentences.text: A **burst** pipe flooded the flat below, and we had to pay for the damage.
sentences.translation: **Yorilgan** quvur tufayli pastki qavatdagi xonadonni suv bosdi, zararni biz to'lashga majbur bo'ldik.

sentences.text: Add a teaspoon of **ground** cumin to the meat before you fry it.
sentences.translation: Qovurishdan oldin go'shtga bir choy qoshiq **yanchilgan** zira qo'shing.

sentences.text: The kitchen floor was covered with **spilt** milk and broken eggs.
sentences.translation: Oshxona poli **to'kilgan** sut va singan tuxumlarga to'lib ketgan edi.

sentences.text: Is this just a **mistaken** belief, or is there some truth in it?
sentences.translation: Bu shunchaki **xato** tasavvurmi yoki unda qandaydir haqiqat bormi?

sentences.text: Behind the empty house there was an **overgrown** garden full of apricot trees.
sentences.translation: Bo'sh uy ortida o'rik daraxtlariga to'la, **o't bosib ketgan** bog' bor edi.

examples.title: Easy to confuse: **rose** / **raised**, **hung** / **hanged**
examples.description: Shakli o'xshash, lekin har xil fe'llar: rise (o'zi ko'tariladi) va raise (nimanidir ko'taradi), wind va wound, hang (osmoq) va hanged (dorga osmoq), bear va be born, flow va fly, sow va sew.

sentences.text: Prices **rose** by ten per cent last year, while salaries stayed the same.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili narxlar o'n foizga **oshdi**, maoshlar esa o'zgarmadi.

sentences.text: The landlord **has raised** the rent again, so we're looking for a cheaper flat.
sentences.translation: Uy egasi ijara haqini yana **oshirdi**, shuning uchun arzonroq kvartira qidiryapmiz.

sentences.text: Two soldiers **were wounded** in the attack and taken to hospital by helicopter.
sentences.translation: Hujumda ikki askar **yaralandi** va vertolyotda shifoxonaga olib ketildi.

sentences.text: She **wound** a long scarf round her neck and went out into the snow.
sentences.translation: U bo'yniga uzun sharfni **o'radi** va qorli ko'chaga chiqdi.

sentences.text: We **hung** the new curtains ourselves, but it took the whole afternoon.
sentences.translation: Yangi pardalarni o'zimiz **osdik**, lekin bunga butun tushdan keyingi vaqt ketdi.

sentences.text: In the Middle Ages, criminals **were hanged** in the main square of the town.
sentences.translation: O'rta asrlarda jinoyatchilar shaharning bosh maydonida **dorga osilgan**.

sentences.text: Although she **was born** in London, Malika has always felt at home in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Malika Londonda **tug'ilgan** bo'lsa ham, Toshkentda doim o'zini uyidagidek his qilgan.

sentences.text: After the storm the river **flowed** so fast that the bridge was closed.
sentences.translation: Bo'rondan keyin daryo shunchalik tez **oqdiki**, ko'prikni yopib qo'yishdi.

sentences.text: The farmers **have** already **sown** the winter wheat in the fields around Jizzakh.
sentences.translation: Fermerlar Jizzax atrofidagi dalalarga kuzgi bug'doyni allaqachon **ekib bo'lishdi**.

sentences.text: My aunt **sewed** all the costumes for the school play by hand.
sentences.translation: Xolam maktab spektakli uchun barcha liboslarni qo'lda **tikdi**.
